accepted_no_wait_budget.scope: CPU-only satisfied-target registry admission, 32 concurrent callers
accepted_no_wait_budget.basis: Ninefold headroom over the observed maximum 0.000533-second batch; this isolates readiness admission from retrieval, limiter, GPU, and storage work.

measured_cpu_control.cleanup_evidence: Each sample uses a registry capped at 32 observers, then completes two consecutive 32-waiter waves; the second full wave succeeds only after the first wave unregisters.

live_service_comparison.environment: Windows 11, Python 3.13.14, CUDA, vaultspec-rag 0.4.28, managed Qdrant 1.19.0

acceptance.live_service_follow_up: Compare future runs only on the same host, service build, roots, request count, concurrency, and resident-service topology.
